name: codex-paper-factory
description: Codex PaperFactory: long-horizon research automation with durable logs, phase gates, scientific figures, and conference-paper drafting checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a research task into auditable experiments, figures, and paper drafts.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for turning an initial research task into a long-running, auditable paper-production workflow: scope, literature survey, baseline matrix, data sanity, experiments, ablations, scientific figures, conference-paper drafting, and internal review.
defaultPrompt: Run autonomous research on this topic for one week.
Resume the research project and advance the next gate.
Create paper-ready figures and a conference draft from evidence.
Audit my manuscript and prepare citation/data availability checks.
